p0.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi diamond polishing wheels for half bullnose edges on the Bulldog and Bi-Bulldog profiling machines. These are the final step after shaping and finishing: run the edge through the grits in order and a cut porcelain or stone edge comes up to match the polished face of the tile. Available in 10 mm and 15 mm radius.

Fits

  • Raimondi Bulldog Advanced and Bi-Bulldog Advanced

Specifications

  • Profile: half bullnose, 10 or 15 mm radius
  • Grits: 400, 800, 1500 and 1800
  • Continuous rim diamond polishing wheels
  • Raimondi lists its 15 mm half bullnose polishing wheels as Art. 179BU15LB (800), 179BU15LC (1500) and 179BU15LD (1800)

Good to know

  • Work up through the grits without skipping. Each grit removes the scratches from the one before.
  • Granite can need an extra pass at a mid grit between finishing and polishing.
  • Keep the water pumps running. Polishing wheels glaze quickly if they run dry.

p1.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi half bullnose diamond shaping wheels for the Bulldog and Bi-Bulldog profiling machines. This is the first step: the coarse shaping wheel mills the square edge of the tile or stone into a rounded half bullnose, removing most of the material fast. Choose a segmented rim in 10, 15, 20 or 30 mm radius, or the 10 mm continuous rim option.

Fits

  • Raimondi Bulldog Advanced and Bi-Bulldog Advanced

Specifications

  • Profile: half bullnose
  • Segmented rim, coarse grit: 10, 15, 20 or 30 mm radius (Raimondi Art. 179BULL10, 179BULL15-125, 179BULL20, 179BULL30)
  • Continuous rim, very coarse grit: 10 mm radius (Raimondi Art. 179BULL10FC)

Good to know

  • Match the finishing and polishing wheels to the same radius so the profile stays true through all three steps.
  • The Bulldog Advanced comes with a 10 mm radius shaping wheel, so the other radii are the add-ons.
  • Suits marble, granite and porcelain. Keep the water pumps running so the wheel stays cool.

p2.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi Raizor MkII is a rail cutting system for large format porcelain slabs. Two connectable rails join to score a straight line up to 330 cm long, then the included Snap pliers break the slab clean along the score. It is the standard way to cut 3 metre panels on site without a saw, for tiles 3 to 12 mm thick.

Features

  • Two connectable rails, each with a 160 cm cutting length
  • Six dual lip suction cups (three per rail), 95 mm, stain free rubber with release tabs, suited to moderately textured tiles
  • Tilting die cast aluminium cutting unit on a single rail, running on three bearing wheels
  • 22 mm TiAlN coated scoring wheel with built in bearing

Specifications

  • Maximum cut: 330 cm, or 450 cm with the 100 cm extension (Art. 433CP00P100)
  • Tile thickness: 3 to 12 mm with the included pliers
  • Weight: about 6.6 kg
  • Model: 433CP00AR

What's in the box

  • Two rails with suction cups, cutting unit, Snap pliers (Art. 169TB RAI), padded carry bag

Good to know

  • For 12 to 20 mm tiles add the heavy duty pliers (Art. 169TM01AN).

p3.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi Raizor MTC2X is the compact modular version of the Raizor rail cutter. Two short rails clip together for a 153 cm score, so it handles 120 x 120 and 60 x 120 tiles and plank formats on site without the length of the full 330 cm system, and it packs into a small bag. The included Premium pliers snap tiles from 3 to 15 mm thick.

Features

  • Two combinable extruded aluminium rails, cutting unit runs on both
  • Four dual lip suction cups, 95 mm, stain free rubber with release tabs and handles that rotate 180 degrees
  • Die cast aluminium scoring unit on three bearing wheels, adjustable for parallelism
  • 20 mm titanium coated scoring wheel with built in bearing, simple to replace

Specifications

  • Tile thickness: 3 to 15 mm with the included pliers
  • Weight: about 5.3 kg
  • Model: 433CP00AM2

What's in the box

  • Two rails, cutting unit, Premium pliers (Art. 169TX01AR), padded bag with shoulder straps

Good to know

  • Extra rail sections can be joined for longer cuts, and the Power Raizor MkII cutting unit runs on the same rails.
  • For tiles over 15 mm add the heavy duty pliers (Art. 169TM01AN).

p4.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi Raizor MkII Plus is the heavy duty version of the Raizor rail cutter for large format porcelain. Its scoring unit bridges a double rail, which keeps the wheel dead straight over a 330 cm score, and the included Premium pliers snap slabs up to 15 mm thick. It is the pick for 20 mm pavers and thick slabs where the standard MkII runs out of capacity.

Use it for

  • Scoring and snapping porcelain slabs up to 330 cm long
  • Thicker material from 3 to 15 mm

Features

  • Bridge scoring unit running on a double rail
  • Six integrated suction cups
  • Titanium coated scoring wheel with built in bearing (20 mm, Art. 135D20CTRIC)
  • Premium progressive pressure pliers for 3 to 15 mm

Specifications

  • Maximum cut: 330 cm
  • Tile thickness: 3 to 15 mm with the included pliers
  • Weight: about 7.3 kg
  • Model: 433CP00APR

Good to know

  • For tiles over 15 mm, Raimondi's heavy duty pliers (Art. 169TM01AN) go to 20 mm.
  • The Power Raizor MkII cutting unit mounts on the rails for 45 degree mitres with an angle grinder.
  • Wipe the slab before you set the rail so the suction cups hold.

p5.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi Kompass scores large circles in large format porcelain using the same score and snap method as the Raizor. A suction cup holds the centre to the slab, the arm swings a diamond scoring wheel around it, and a ruler on the arm reads off the diameter. It is how you cut a clean round hole for a floor waste, column or basin in a 3 metre slab on site.

Use it for

  • Round holes for columns, drains and pedestals in large format tiles
  • Semicircles and quarter circles to round off a slab corner

Specifications

  • Centred holes: 22 to 100 cm diameter
  • Off centre holes: 32 to 100 cm diameter
  • 16 mm diamond scoring wheel with pin and bearings
  • Metric and imperial ruler with pointer
  • Weight: about 1.2 kg
  • Model: 433KOMP 50

Good to know

  • After scoring the circle, finish the cut by removing wedges with an angle grinder, then clean up the small tabs left behind.
  • Wipe the slab before you set the suction cup so it holds through the whole score.
  • Score in one steady pass. Going back over the line chips the glaze.

p6.descriptionHtml:
The original Raimondi Power Raizor is an angle grinder cutting jig that runs along the Raizor rail guide. Clamp your grinder in, set the angle, and the jig carries the blade in a straight line along the rail, so mitres and straight cuts in porcelain slabs come out as true as a bridge saw cut. Angle grinder not included.

Use it for

  • 45 degree mitre (jolly) cuts for external corners on slab edges
  • 90 degree straight cuts
  • 180 degree slots and half bullnose
  • Intermediate angles of 30, 47 and 70 degrees

Features

  • Fits most popular angle grinders
  • Connects to a vacuum for dust free cutting

Compatible with

  • Raimondi Raizor cutting guides
  • Raimondi wet cut and dust suppression kit (Art. 433PWW A), sold separately
  • Raimondi dust containment device (Art. 433PWZP A), sold separately

Good to know

  • For wet cutting the grinder must be cordless or rated IP54 or better.
  • Cut mitres in two or three passes on thick slabs rather than one deep plunge.
  • Raimondi's current version is the Power Raizor MkII, listed separately.

p7.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi Power Raizor MkII turns a Raizor rail into a guided grinder saw. Mount your angle grinder in the unit, set it on the rail, and it carries a 125 mm diamond blade in a dead straight line for 90 degree cuts and 45 degree mitres on porcelain slabs, with a tilting plunge for cutouts and openings. Angle grinder not included.

Use it for

  • Mitred edges for external corners, benchtops and stair treads
  • Straight cuts and square or rectangular openings in slabs

Features

  • Cuts from 90 degrees down to 45 degrees including intermediate angles
  • Tilting plunge cut for depth adjustment and multi pass cutting
  • Four support wheels on the tile and four wheels on the rail
  • Dry cutting with a dust extractor port, or wet with the water kit

Specifications

  • Blade: 125 mm turbo diamond disc (Art. 179CCT125SP), included
  • Maximum cut: 20 mm at 90 degrees, 16 mm at 45 degrees
  • Arbor: M14
  • Weight: about 3.5 kg
  • Model: 433PWRM2EUD

Fits

  • Raimondi Raizor MK2, MK2 PLUS and modular (MTC2X) rail systems

Good to know

  • Not for the original Raizor guide (Art. 433CR R).
  • For wet cutting the grinder must be cordless or rated IP54 or better.
